prior_art_5_percent_reason: Explicitly prohibited by M1 research architecture: another paper's post-hoc/adopted 5% is not an independent D1 tolerance justification.
blocker: Exact output-specific tolerances and their uncertainty/engineering justification are explicitly unresolved in canonical M1 architecture.
required_to_unblock: Lock exact reference R formulation and output extraction.
Quantify numerical/reference uncertainty for each primary output.
Define intended engineering use-case or decision sensitivity.
Choose and justify epsilon_w, epsilon_K and epsilon_Q before inspecting final validation/error surfaces.
Record human threshold review and timestamp the freeze.

rows.metric: e_w = |w_M - w_R| / |w_R|, with an alternative normalized/absolute metric required where the denominator is near zero.
rows.physical_meaning: Relative model-form error in primary deflection output between reduced model M1 and reference R.
rows.uncertainty_basis: NOT_YET_QUANTIFIED: experimental measurement uncertainty, reference-model numerical uncertainty, engineering-use tolerance and near-zero denominator handling remain to be specified.
rows.acceptance_threshold: UNDEFINED — NOT FROZEN. No VALID classification is permitted until epsilon_w is justified independently of final validation outcomes.
rows.breakdown_threshold: UNDEFINED — NOT FROZEN. INVALID/breakdown classification cannot be instantiated before epsilon_w is frozen.
rows.validity_boundary_definition: Future boundary for this output is the locus e_w(x)=epsilon_w after epsilon_w is independently justified and frozen.
rows.breakdown_criterion: Future criterion: e_w(x)>epsilon_w after predeclaration; currently non-executable.

rows.metric: e_K = |K_M - K_R| / |K_R|, with an alternative normalized/absolute metric required where appropriate.
rows.physical_meaning: Relative model-form error in effective bending stiffness.
rows.uncertainty_basis: NOT_YET_QUANTIFIED: extraction method, experimental/reference uncertainty and engineering-use tolerance remain provisional.
rows.acceptance_threshold: UNDEFINED — NOT FROZEN. No VALID classification is permitted until epsilon_K is independently justified.

rows.metric: e_Q = |Q_slip,M - Q_slip,R| / |Q_slip,R|, with event-detection uncertainty explicitly included.
rows.physical_meaning: Relative model-form error in slip-transition load/force.
rows.uncertainty_basis: NOT_YET_QUANTIFIED: slip-event detection, experimental noise, reference discretization/contact convergence and intended use-case tolerance remain unresolved.
rows.acceptance_threshold: UNDEFINED — NOT FROZEN. No accepted/rejected classification is permitted until epsilon_Q is justified.
